title: Water Leak Customer Request Form
subtitle: An original water leak workflow that preserves the customer's observation and routes a clear service response, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete water leak customer request form for the suspected or confirmed water-release location that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when a customer asks for service, investigation, or follow-up and staff need a traceable account of the requested outcome, symptoms, evidence, safety screen, communication, and disposition. The leak response coordinator owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: Water leak customer request and communication routing
sections.guidance: Capture the customer's own observation and give the request a clear service owner.

sections.title: Water leak requested outcome and customer constraints
sections.guidance: Describe the requested result without treating the customer's suspected cause as confirmed.

blocks.label: Customer request type
items: Active leak or uncontrolled water
Intermittent drip or recurring moisture
High usage or moving-meter concern
Low pressure or suspected service-line leak
Roof, ceiling, wall, floor, or window intrusion
Fixture, appliance, drain, or equipment leak
Post-repair verification or recurrence
Damage, drying, restoration, or insurance documentation

blocks.label: Customer observation in their own words

fields.label: What was observed, when it began, frequency, affected service, desired outcome, and prior contact

sections.title: Water leak condition timeline and supplied evidence
sections.guidance: Preserve dates, sources, and attachments so service staff can distinguish symptoms from verified findings.

blocks.label: Customer-supplied evidence
items: Photograph or video reference
Bill, usage, or account reference
Display, alarm, or fault wording
Prior ticket or service record
Site plan, equipment document, or product reference
Access instruction, property permission, or appointment detail
Critical-service or accessibility information
No supporting attachment; follow-up owner assigned

sections.title: Water leak exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Water contacting electrical equipment, outlets, panels, cords, or machinery
Bulging or sagging ceiling, unstable finish, structural movement, or falling material
Suspected sewage, chemical, fire-water, or other contaminated release
Rapid flooding, washout, sinkhole, severe pressure, or uncontrolled flow
Slip exposure, hidden opening, poor visibility, or unsafe access
Shutoff would impair fire protection, medical, process, or critical service
Gas odor, steam, hot water, refrigerant, or unknown fluid is also present
Condition exceeds responder authority, equipment, training, or protective controls
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not enter water near electrical equipment, stand below a sagging ceiling, or handle suspected contaminated water. Keep occupants clear and use the organization's emergency route for rapid flooding, structural movement, gas odor, or critical-service impact. Only authorized personnel may operate shutoffs after evaluating downstream consequences.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each customer request exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: Water leak decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Suspected or confirmed water-release location identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
